verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency (for example, an EU versus US service region). The security-page item about a U.S. government authorization is a compliance attestation, not a user-selectable residency option, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
